I.value_zh: project_dir、fcop.json、HOME、写侧工具及 TASK-001 的追加关系；父任务正文不在 allowed Context，无法核对其工具分类与原七项验收。
I.value_en: project_dir, fcop.json, HOME, write-side tools, and the append relation to TASK-001; the parent body is outside allowed Context, so its tool classification and seven original criteria cannot be checked.

O.value_zh: S1–S3 的三步守门、精确 HOME 例外和统一测试明确；合并后的 TASK-001/002 完整交付仍依赖未提供的父任务正文。
O.value_en: S1–S3 specify the three-step guard, exact-HOME exception, and uniform tests; the complete combined TASK-001/002 deliverables still depend on the unavailable parent body.
O.notes_zh: 不把父任务候选清单自动当作本案允许上下文。
O.notes_en: The parent candidate list is not silently imported as allowed context.

A.value_zh: 把全部写侧工具接入同一三步守门并用参数化测试核查；但新项目须先运行 init_* 创建 fcop.json，而 S1 要求写侧工具运行前已有 fcop.json，原文未说明初始化工具是否例外。
A.value_en: Route every write-side tool through the same three-step guard and parameterized tests; a new project must run init_* to create fcop.json while S1 requires fcop.json before a write-side call, and the source does not state whether initialization tools are exempt.
A.notes_zh: 不能自行宣布 init_* 为普通写侧工具或守门例外；需核对父任务与明确启动规则。
A.notes_en: Do not silently classify init_* as ordinary guarded writes or as exemptions; the parent and bootstrap rule must be checked.

P.value_zh: ADMIN 决定批准、调整或延后合并范围；ME 只在获准后实施；本案未指派 OPS，且未提供可核验的当前 GREEN 记录。
P.value_en: ADMIN decides whether to approve, adjust, or defer the combined scope; ME implements only after approval. This addendum does not assign OPS, and no verifiable current GREEN record is supplied.
P.notes_zh: frontmatter done 与正文拟议时点可能不同；不由状态标签反推执行授权。
P.notes_en: Front-matter done and the proposal-time body may refer to different times; status labels do not imply execution authority.

R.value_zh: 原文未给出执行期限或资源预算；精确 HOME 拒绝、子目录放行及 Path.resolve/casefold 是作用域和实现规则。
R.value_en: No execution deadline or resource budget is supplied; exact-HOME refusal, subdirectory allowance, and Path.resolve/casefold are scope and implementation rules.
R.notes_zh: P0/P1 是各补丁优先级；不能把路径谓词误归资源配额。
R.notes_en: P0/P1 are patch priorities; path predicates are not resource budgets.

V.value_zh: TASK-001 引用存在，正文缺失。

C.value_zh: S1–S3 的三项增补验收明确；合并后的十项还依赖父任务七项，且新项目 init_* 是否通过共同守门缺少可核验判据。
C.value_en: The three S1–S3 added criteria are explicit; the combined ten also depend on seven parent criteria, and whether new-project init_* passes the shared guard lacks a verifiable predicate.
C.notes_zh: 不把父案七项或初始化例外凭空补写。
C.notes_en: Do not invent the parent's seven criteria or a bootstrap exemption.

B.value_zh: 拒绝精确 HOME、drive root 与列出的 Unix system roots；合法 HOME 子目录不得误拒；本任务不扩充到 Desktop/Documents 严格模式，未获 ADMIN 批准不得开工。
B.value_en: Reject exact HOME, drive roots, and listed Unix system roots; do not wrongly reject valid HOME subdirectories; strict Desktop/Documents denial is outside this task, and implementation must await ADMIN approval.
B.notes_zh: 子目录例外以解析并规范化后的路径比较为准。
B.notes_en: The subdirectory exception is evaluated on resolved and normalized paths.
